prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: birthday invitation background; website text is added separately.
Primary request: make ONLY the cake and its cream pedestal a clearly cartoony 2D illustration, with simple rounded shapes, smooth confident burgundy ink contours, flat pastel fills and just one soft shadow tone. This must be a visible transformation from the detailed watercolor reference. Simplify the frosting into playful chunky scallops and distinct rounded cream swirls with minimal interior lines; simplify the small cake bows into clean readable cartoon bow shapes. Draw the three cherries as rounded cherry-red shapes with a single simple highlight and curved stems. Draw the three striped candles with tidy bold stripes and small graphic flame shapes. The cake should feel charming, intentionally drawn and polished, like a printed illustrated birthday card. No gritty brushwork or repeated micro-details inside the cake. No realism, glossy 3D, airbrushing, complicated shading, photoreal frosting or oil-painted texture.
Constraints: retain the exact framing, aspect ratio, cake location, scale and silhouette of the supplied edit target; preserve pink cake, cream frosting, three cherries, three lit striped candles, three small burgundy bows on the cake and cream cake stand. Keep the existing pale warm ivory paper background, quiet tabletop wash and empty text space. Keep the outer ribbon removed. Do not add new objects, faces or characters. No text, lettering, watermark or border. Output a full-bleed background image only.
Input image: edit target, square artwork. Keep its framing unchanged.
